notes: Added missing stories to meet minimum and cover schema, core logic, API, tests, and integration.

FEAT-3-S68.title: Clinical Trials Search Input/Output Schema
FEAT-3-S68.description: Define and validate Pydantic models for clinical trial search inputs (condition, location, radius) and structured outputs including trial metadata, recruiting status, and distance fields.

FEAT-3-S69.title: ClinicalTrials.gov Search Core Logic
FEAT-3-S69.description: Implement core service logic to query ClinicalTrials.gov API with recruiting filter, parse trial results, extract locations, and normalize response structure.

FEAT-3-S70.title: Travel Distance Calculation for Trial Locations
FEAT-3-S70.description: Integrate Google Routes API to compute travel distance and duration from user location to each trial site and append results to trial output.

FEAT-3-S71.title: EvaluateCare Facade Integration for Trials Search
FEAT-3-S71.description: Integrate clinical trials service into EvaluateCare facade to orchestrate validated input, service execution, and formatted response delivery to the tool layer.

FEAT-3-S72.title: Clinical Trials Search Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-3-S72.description: Create unit tests for clinical trials service (API parsing, filtering, distance computation) and integration tests validating end-to-end tool invocation through tool router.
FEAT-3-S72.evidence: GAP: No existing clinical trials test file found; must create tests aligned with backend/tests patterns
